paper_title: Operation of a ferromagnetic axion haloscope at $m_a=58\,μ$eV
coupling_convention: g_ae (dimensionless axion-electron coupling constant), canonical form
notes: First experimental result constraining axion-electron coupling using ferromagnetic haloscope. Mass m_a = 58 μeV (14 GHz). Upper limit g_aee < 4.9×10^-10 at 95% C.L. from preliminary dark matter search. DM density ρ_dm = 0.45 GeV/cm³ assumed (standard galactic halo model). Paper explicitly states this is the first measurement of coupling between cosmological axions and electrons. The coupling constant is dimensionless and follows the DFSZ axion model convention. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.75, 30)) | Vision: Fig. 8 shows the exclusion plot for g_ae coupling vs axion mass around m_a = 58 μeV.
